chapters.title: Start the game
chapters.goal: Start a new game and follow the opening on the airship.
hints: The title screen needs START or A; menus can be driven with the touch screen too.
The opening is a story scene: advancing the text is the whole action.
The game explains its own systems as it goes; read the dialogue.

chapters.title: Learn the battles
chapters.goal: Win the first battles and learn the battle menu.
hints: The battle menu is Fight, Magic, Item, Run (and later Auto): the D-pad picks, A confirms.
Row matters: characters in the back row take less physical damage but hit less hard with weapons.
Use Potions when HP drops; do not wait until someone is nearly down.

chapters.title: Kaipo and the Watery Pass
chapters.goal: Reach Kaipo, then get through the Watery Pass (Antlion's cave).
hints: Talk to the people in town: the game tells you the next place through them.
Buy Potions and better armour when you can afford it.
Save on the world map whenever the game offers it.

chapters.title: Follow the crystals
chapters.goal: Follow the story through the crystal quests and the dungeons between them.
hints: The story moves through towns and dungeons: talk, then travel.
The party changes as the story goes; check the equipment of new members.
Magic is the answer to most bosses: attack their weakness rather than only attacking.

chapters.title: The underworld
chapters.goal: Follow the story into the underworld and keep the party ready for the harder fights.
hints: Levels and equipment matter more than speed here: fight the encounters you meet.
Keep a healer in the party with a group-healing spell before a boss.
Save often: dungeons here are long.
